methods.scope: Candidate 73-record report cohort inferred from the retained original special-station microcystin calendar, with exact selected chlorophyll clocks disambiguating repeated routine station-dates.
methods.source_selection_status: Inferred reproducible selection; publisher Table 8 does not identify its individual activity IDs.
methods.published_comparison: Table 8 station values manually transcribed from the original PDF; fixed 0.008 ug/L substitution is applied only for the report-method comparison.
methods.sampling_protocol: Published report describes surface (0.3 m) microcystin sampling alongside chlorophyll. Individual WQP microcystin depth fields are blank.
methods.original_censoring: Original below-limit values are intervals [0, reporting limit). Four selected April 5 records have 0.1 ug/L limits; other selected below-limit records have 0.016 ug/L limits.
methods.precision_sensitivity: Exact decimal half-up rounding of quantified source values to 0.001 ug/L before aggregation is an explicitly labelled sensitivity calculation, not a verified publisher computation.
methods.statistics: Arithmetic mean; sample standard deviation with denominator n-1; final display uses three decimal places.
methods.paired_analysis_relationship: This report-reconciliation cohort includes original August 24 dates and does not modify the separate 67 exact-date/time cross-analyte links or 128 microcystin contrasts.
methods.interpretation: The same-clock August 24/September 5 observation is reported as an original source discrepancy; no sample date is replaced.
